$comment: Deckback runtime config, read by the launcher at startup. Keys starting with '$' are comments and are ignored. A per-user user.json overrides the caption and touch keys.
$comment_user_agent: Must stay the Cobalt TV client form. Desktop or SteamDeck tokens make YouTube serve a different TV style bundle with opaque overlay text backgrounds.

quality.$comment: steer_av1_unsupported: the launcher makes AV1 report as unsupported (isTypeSupported, canPlayType, mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo) so YouTube serves VP9/H.264. max_height and prefer_codecs are not read by the launcher.

$comment_mic: mic_autogrant: grant microphone access to the app origin only, so no permission prompt appears in Game Mode.
$comment_cdm: Opt-in Widevine CDM fetch. Empty (the default) means never fetch; the launcher only uses a CDM already installed. To opt in, set cdm_url to a libwidevinecdm.so you trust and cdm_sha256 to its SHA-256; the launcher refuses a file whose hash does not match. Only DRM/paid content needs it.

power.$comment: While a video plays the launcher holds a logind idle inhibitor, polling play state over DevTools every devtools_poll_ms (needs remote_debugging_port). On resume it waits up to resume_online_timeout_ms (0 = don't wait) for resume_probe_host:resume_probe_port to accept a connection before resuming playback. idle_inhibit_synthetic_fallback is not implemented: true only logs a warning.
power.$comment_keep_awake: SteamOS dims and suspends mid-video unless the host-side helper deckback-idle-nudge.service is running (`just idle-nudge`). When keep_awake_warn is true, the launcher checks for it once on the first playback and shows a one-time toast if it is not active; it stays silent if it cannot tell. Set false to suppress the toast.
power.$comment_reload: On resume after a sleep of at least this many ms, reload the page instead of just resuming play(), to refresh stale stream URLs. 0 = never reload (default); e.g. 3600000 = 1 h.
power.$comment_self_update: 'off' = never check (update via `flatpak update`/Discover); 'notify' (default) = show an 'Update available' card and update only when the user picks 'Update now' (also in the Menu); 'auto' = install any newer commit in the background, applied on next launch, with no rollback. Updates only this app, via the Flatpak portal, without root. The legacy boolean self_update still parses (true = auto, false = off).

log.$comment: Size-rotating log file: rotates at log_max_bytes and keeps log_max_files old files. Empty log_directory uses $DECKBACK_LOG_DIR, else logs/ under $XDG_STATE_HOME/deckback. log_mirror_stderr also copies lines to stderr (journald/Steam).

$comment_cobalt_flags: Hardware decode (M138): VA-API needs BOTH --enable-features=VaapiVideoDecodeLinuxGL AND --use-angle=gl; with only the feature, ANGLE stays on Vulkan and decode silently falls back to software. After any Cobalt bump, re-confirm with the PIXEL check (a composited screenshot through tests/deck/lib/probes.py:video_corruption_verdict, never the decoder name or corruptedVideoFrames alone) and revert to software decode if it regresses. Do NOT add --ignore-gpu-blocklist or VaapiIgnoreDriverChecks: they change no decoder selection and only suppress real driver checks. See findings durable/hardware.md.

keymap.$comment: Deck control -> semantic action or a DOM key value sent verbatim ('Enter', 'Escape', 'MediaPlayPause', 'c', 'ArrowUp', ...). A DOM key value wins over an action name. Actions with no known key are logged at startup instead of dispatching.
keymap.$comment_unmapped: scan_rewind, scan_forward, player_menu and voice_search have no known Leanback key, so binding them only logs them as unmapped at startup.
keymap.$comment_start: Menu (start) always opens Settings, whatever it is mapped to. The show_controls value is legacy and ignored.
keymap.$comment_seek: scrub_back/scrub_fwd (LB/RB) send ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to move Leanback's progress bar. chapter_back/chapter_fwd (LT/RT) jump to the previous/next chapter via config/scripts/chapter_seek.js, falling back to a ±skip_seconds jump when a video has no chapters; skip_back/skip_fwd always do the fixed jump. The deprecated names seek_back_10/seek_fwd_10 still resolve to scrub and warn at startup.
keymap.$comment_captions: toggle_captions (View) is a launcher action, not a DOM key: it runs config/scripts/toggle_captions.js to turn captions on or off through the player. Bind it to any button to move it.

$comment_gesture_toggle: toggle_gestures (Y) is a launcher action that turns touch gestures off and back on at runtime, with a toast and a rumble. It does nothing unless gestures were enabled at launch (touch_gestures true, disable_touch false).
$comment_layers: Optional keymap layers that override the base keymap; all ship empty. keymap_player applies on the watch view and keymap_osk while a text field has focus (unbound controls fall through to the base map); both need remote_debugging_port. A non-empty keymap_lt/keymap_rt turns that trigger into a hold modifier: it stops firing its own binding and swallows controls the layer does not bind. Layers may also bind up/down/left/right.
$comment_error_page: error_page: on a failed navigation, show the launcher's own error page with a focused Try again button (Enter/Space) and retry automatically with exponential backoff from error_retry_min_ms to error_retry_max_ms. Set false for Chromium's error page, which no controller can operate; the launcher then also stops detecting the failure.
$comment_error_text: error_title and error_hint override the error page's wording; empty means derive it from the net:: error. This is the R1 hotfix surface: if Leanback stops loading, the explanation users see can be changed here without a rebuild. Text is escaped, so quotes and backslashes are safe.
$comment_first_run: Show a one-time controls card once the TV app has loaded, built from the current keymap. Any button dismisses it, and the same list stays available in Settings > Keys. Delete $XDG_STATE_HOME/deckback/first_run_v1 to see it again.
$comment_right_stick: The right stick sends the same arrow keys as the D-pad, repeating every right_stick_slow_ms at the deadzone edge down to right_stick_fast_ms at full deflection. right_stick_deadzone is in raw stick units (max 32767). Ignored while the D-pad or left stick holds a direction; set right_stick_scroll false to leave the stick unused.
$comment_skip_seconds: Fixed seek interval in seconds (1-600), used by skip_back/skip_fwd, the chapter_back/chapter_fwd fallback when a video has no chapters, and touch double-tap seek.
$comment_captions_toast: Show a brief toast on each caption toggle: 'Captions on', 'Captions off', or 'No captions for this video'. Set false to hide it; the toggle still works.
$comment_caption_control: 'local' (default): captions auto-apply from caption_languages on each video, the on/off state carries across videos, and View toggles it. 'youtube': View is a plain on/off toggle in the system language, with no auto-start or language list. Editable in OSD > Settings > Captions and saved to user.json; YouTube's account-level caption default is a separate setting.
$comment_caption_languages: Ordered list of preferred caption languages, tried first to last when captions turn on. Entries are language codes ('en', 'de', ...) matched on the primary subtag ('pt' matches 'pt-BR'); 'system' means the Steam Deck system language. Empty falls back to caption_language, then 'system'. Editable in OSD > Settings > Captions and saved to user.json.
$comment_caption_type: Which track to prefer within a language: 'author_first' (default; author > auto-generated > translated), 'auto_first', 'author_only', or 'auto_only'. Editable in the OSD Captions tab and saved to user.json.
$comment_caption_remember: Keep the caption on/off state across app restarts (saved as caption_on in user.json). When false, each launch takes the state from the first video.
$comment_caption_on: Saved caption on/off state, used only when caption_remember is true. Written by the launcher; not normally edited by hand.
$comment_caption_language: Deprecated single-language scalar: it seeds caption_languages when that list is empty. Use caption_languages instead.
$comment_touch_gestures: Mobile-style touch gestures, default off (touch support cannot be auto-detected). Mutually exclusive with disable_touch, which wins if both are true. Swipe moves the selection touch_max_steps times (firing after touch_step_px of travel or on release); a swipe from within touch_edge_px of the left edge is Back; a tap is Enter; a double-tap within touch_double_tap_ms on the left/right third seeks -/+skip_seconds, accumulating on repeats; holding touch_long_press_ms sets the playback rate until release (left third touch_hold_slow_rate, elsewhere touch_hold_rate, snapped to the player's nearest rate). touch_poll_ms is how often the launcher collects gestures.
$comment_touch_hide_cursor: Hide the mouse pointer while touch gestures are on (disable_touch hides it on its own). Set false to keep the pointer visible.
$comment_touch_multitouch: Multitouch is ignored: a touch sequence that ever sees a second finger produces no gesture and is only counted.
$comment_disable_touch: Make the touchscreen inert (default on): the page swallows every pointer, mouse and touch event and hides the cursor, and gamescope's touch mode is held at hover (taps do not click) while the app window is focused. Set false to restore raw touch, where taps click.
$comment_touch_lock_removed: The removed touch_lock_* and block_touchscreen keys are still accepted and ignored.
